data.name: Naveed
data.gender_notes: Naveed is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Persian navīd, 'good news, glad tidings'. Its root is Persian navīd. A Persian and Urdu given name. Naveed is a Persian name meaning “Good news; glad tidings”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Naveed expresses “Good news; glad tidings”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Persian navīd, 'good news, glad tidings'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naveed total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
